caption:
Four days off, late films and a fridge full of food at midnight. No wonder Boxing Day sleep feels broken.

This year the bank holiday moves to Monday 28 December, so you've got a long weekend to get back on track.

The Aviva 2025 sleep survey found 75% of UK adults have caffeine after 2pm. Over Christmas that includes the coffee with pudding and the chocolate tin.

What time did you go to bed last night? Be honest.

Save this for tonight, and send it to the night owl in your house.

#SleepTipsUK #BoxingDay #SleepReset #HealthyHabitsUK #UKWellness
